name: TC-309: the chain shell Menu tab is the shared view — no per-location controls, local items hidden
description: /chain/:groupId/restaurantManagement?tab=Menu: banner 'This is your shared menu — changes here apply to all 2 locations…'; 'Manage shared menu (all locations)' button; the shared item's availability switch is disabled and it has no $ / carry icons; A's location-only item is not listed at all (?sharedItemsOnly=true).

testStage.description: /chain/:groupId/restaurantManagement?tab=Menu: banner 'This is your shared menu — changes here apply to all 2 locations…'; 'Manage shared menu (all locations)' button; the shared item's availability switch is disabled and it has no $ / carry icons; A's location-only item is not listed at all (?sharedItemsOnly=true).

steps.name: Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /^Manage (Menu|shared menu)|^Open the builder for .* only|^Manage the shared chain menu/ })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/This is your shared menu — changes here apply to all \d+ locations/)
Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('button', { name: /^Manage (Menu|shared menu)|^Open the builder for .* only|^Manage the shared chain menu/ })
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ })

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 29dd2c67' }).first()

Expect "toBeDisabled" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 29dd2c67' }).first().getByRole('switch')

Expect "toHaveCount" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 29dd2c67' }).first().getByTestId('menu-price-override').or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 29dd2c67' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: /(Using shared price|Location price)/ })).first()

Expect "toHaveCount" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 29dd2c67' }).first().getByTestId('menu-carry-toggle').or(locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByRole('listitem').filter({ hasText: 'Chain Shared 29dd2c67' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: /(Remove from this location's menu|Add back to this location's menu)/ })).first()
Expect "toHaveCount" locator('.MuiAccordion-root').filter({ has: getByRole('button', { name: /^Automation Menu 29dd2c67 \d+ Available/ }) }).getByText('Chain Local 29dd2c67')
